action: PLAN_REVIEW: Phase 06B execution contract for the Optional Cloud Rewrite Engine, prior to any implementation
reason: Coherent, reversible, governance-consistent. Local rewriting stays the unchanged default (baseline hashes captured). Cloud is reachable only when authenticated AND enabled AND consented AND provider-enabled; since no auth system exists, IsAuthenticated defaults false and the Cloud path is unreachable in live use until a future auth phase. No Desktop or repository secret is permitted. Exact-local fallback on any timeout/error/invalid/conversational/empty output is required and testable. DeepSeek is registered but never called. The backend is scoped minimal, compiling, unit-tested, undeployed, and making no live provider call during verification. Observability records only provider, duration, fallback, cause with no user content.
conditions: Security/privacy review must confirm observability never leaves the backend own operational logging: no third-party analytics sink, no Desktop-side persistence, no cross-session user identifier beyond what auth/rate-limiting already needs.
List and justify in evidence any new NuGet package added via Directory.Packages.props for Fluent.Cloud or Fluent.Backend.
Explicitly decide and document CloudRewriteEnabled/CloudConsentGranted as session-only (default) absent a dedicated persistence design.
Promote ADR-0005 from Proposed to Accepted with a dated changelog referencing this plan verdict as part of the evidence deliverables.
Do not close Phase 06B on agent-relayed narrative alone; closure must capture the user own direct, quoted confirmation through a channel the read-only Judge can independently observe.
rules: escalation E-001 functional scope, E-003 stack change, E-004 secrets, E-009 deployment
requiredNextStep: Proceed to implementation under this contract, folding the five conditions into the focused reviews and final evidence; keep status IMPLEMENTED_AWAITING_USER_REVIEW and do not close on agent narrative alone.
